assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia, characterized by palpitations and lightheadedness
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
This diagnostic procedure was medically necessary to address the recurrent symptoms described in the clinical indication
The appeal addresses the missing precertification (denial code CO-197)
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates prior approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
As the authorization was absent, the claim cannot be processed for payment at this time
You have the right to appeal this determination
Please submit a formal appeal request along with any supporting clinical documentation within the timeframe specified in your member handbook
Failure to adhere to these deadlines may result in the forfeiture of appeal rights
